narrative.overview: CS coursework is exact, so the interface is not softer than the material it holds. Chrome is a near-black ground with one signal-green accent in place of a palette; anything symbolic is monospace; corners are small. Headings and body are sans-serif at real reading sizes.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground, tonal layering instead of shadows for in-page chrome
One accent (signal green) plus semantic danger/warning
Monospace for code/math/chrome-symbols, sans for prose and headings
Small radii (3-8px), hairline borders, no pills in chrome
Two motion durations, two curves, no overshoot

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Green is the only brand color.

rules.name: The Tint-Not-Fill Rule
rules.body: Selection and active rows are accent-bg plus green text, not a solid green block.

rules.name: The Token Bridge Rule
rules.body: Never hardcode a colour; shadcn components read tokens that point at Terminal Precision.

rules.name: The Reading Boundary Rule
rules.body: Mono is for symbols, never for sentences or headings.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Floating Rule
rules.body: A surface gets a shadow only if it overlays other content and is dismissed by clicking away.

rules.name: The Pick-A-Tier Rule
rules.body: A new floating surface picks one of the four shadow tokens.

dos: Do read every colour, radius, shadow, duration from the :root tokens in src/index.css.
Do give every interactive element all eight states.
Do put non-prose text in --font-mono and sentences in --font-sans.
donts: Don't introduce a second brand colour or a gradient.
Don't add a fifth shadow tier or put a shadow on an in-layout panel.
Don't use a coloured side stripe in app chrome.
Don't use monospace for headings or body text.
Don't animate on exit or overshoot.
